description: This source file implements the OCDM plugin for handling DRM systems and key systems via JSON-RPC within the WPEFramework. It defines methods for registering properties, retrieving supported DRM systems, and querying key systems based on DRM names.

classes.name: OCDM
classes.description: A class implementing the OCDM plugin that manages DRM and key system information, exposing properties and methods via JSON-RPC.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers the 'drms' and 'keysystems' properties for the OCDM plugin.

methods.name: KeySystems
methods.description: Retrieves key systems associated with a given DRM name.

methods.name: get_drms
methods.description: Retrieves the list of supported DRM systems along with their key systems.

methods.name: get_keysystems
methods.description: Retrieves key systems for a specified DRM name.
